note: Patcher matrix for B185, built from main at 01973e0 (#265). AN EARLIER VERSION OF THIS NOTE SAID 7449502 AND WAS WRONG: the build ran after #265 merged, not before. That mattered -- a reviewer read the stale commit, correctly observed that two label fixes landed after 7449502, and concluded the artifact predated them. It does not. f290649 is an ancestor of 01973e0, and 01973e0's generator is byte-identical to main's, so the four label fixes are all in what was built. Checkable rather than asserted -- against work/patch_mobile_furniture_pack.py at 01973e0: VF2ScanLabelGroup 8, VF2BehaviorLabelStillFromThisSession 6, VF2BehaviorLabelSlotIsCurrentFor 3, the praise-restart writeback 1, VF2GetVillagerCachedBehaviorLabel 5. Everything merged since the build is test files and this directory's identities data, so no rebuild is required. Seeded per variant from the B184 matrix outputs, NOT from B181: VF2 builds INHERIT assets from the seed, so a seed older than the previous release silently drops the art that release added and the build still reports success. All 32 seed directories were confirmed to exist before this file was written, because a seed directory is created before anything links, so an interrupted run leaves a directory that satisfies no payload contract. B185 EXISTS FOR THREE MERGED FIXES THAT B184 PREDATES: #256 (says where the overlay-guard residual is actually defended), #261 (behaviour labels re-roll once a behaviour actually ends) and #262 (the session gate anchors on the villager it was handed, not on a global naming the last villager to enter a wrapped native behaviour -- without it the caption still re-rolled mid-action whenever several patched villagers interleaved, so #261 alone did not finish the job). The label fix is the player-visible one -- before it, the Home Gym showed one action out of ten and all 47 label groups were equally frozen, because the PERSISTENT label text at villager+0x1BBA8 survives the end of a behaviour and was being read as 'this villager is already doing X'. Export with work/export_release_bundle.py, NEVER work/export_offline_patch_bundle.py directly: B183 shipped twelve features short precisely because the low-level exporter was called directly and the wrapper's guards -- one of which refuses a build whose overlays would be silently absent -- never ran. The B184 seeds must NOT be moved, renamed or deleted: they are inputs to this build, not stale outputs. NOTE ON THE SEED EXECUTABLES: seeds supply ASSETS only; every overlay must be rebuilt from current main and verified individually (faulty 84c0590f85 absent, fixed 84c05974065b present), because nothing anywhere in the release path inspects overlay bytes and that check is the only thing preventing a guard-passing release from shipping the startup crash.
